launch.safeTip: Forces PZ safe mode (-safemode). Use for graphics troubleshooting; this may disable rendering features.
launch.noSoundTip: Disables the game’s sound system (-nosound), independently of voice chat.
launch.imguiTip: Enables PZ’s ImGui interface and Debug (-imgui). Internal tools; availability depends on the game build.
launch.viewportsTip: Enables ImGui viewports and Debug (-imguidebugviewports). Also implies ImGui.
launch.aiTip: Internal AI test switch (-aitest). Its gameplay effects have not been validated here; leave off for normal play.
launch.antiCheatsTip: Sets PZ’s internal anti-cheat flag (-anti-cheats). Does not replace a server’s rules or enable universal mod compatibility.
launch.debugLogTip: Comma-separated PZ DebugType names, optionally prefixed + or -. Example: +General,-Sound. Passed as -debuglog=.
launch.debugConfigTip: Local file passed through -debugcfg=. Read by PZ when Debug is enabled. Not included in shared configurations.
launch.foldersTip: Comma-separated sources: workshop (staging), steam (subscriptions), mods (local). This is source discovery priority, not individual mod load order.
launch.connectTip: Server address passed to +connect. Empty opens the normal menu. Clients and servers must use the same Steam mode.
launch.passwordTip: Passed to +password for direct connection. Kept in memory only, excluded from exports and hidden in command previews.
launch.netLogTip: Enables zomboid.znetlog for network diagnostics. Leave off unless investigating a connection issue.
launch.logSizeTip: PZ console.txt size limit, passed using the game’s property and launch option. 1024 KB = 1 MB.
launch.foldersInvalid: Use workshop, steam and/or mods once each, separated by commas.
launch.logsInvalid: Use comma-separated DebugType names, optionally prefixed + or -.
jvm.adviceTip: Memory is bounded by total and available RAM, with room for Windows, native allocations and shared graphics memory. Automatic mode refreshes this budget before every launch. CPU and Java guide the collector choice; G1 starts at its standard 200 ms target. Xss follows the bundled Windows Java stack reserve. The Apply button updates these fields once. Diagnostic logging remains your choice.
jvm.detectFailed: Hardware detection unavailable. Explicit fallback JVM settings are provided and remain editable.
jvm.xmsTip: Automatically filled. Initial Java heap; must not exceed Xmx. Starting below Xmx leaves memory available at startup.
jvm.stackTip: Automatically filled from the Windows Java stack reserve, with a 1024 KB fallback. Stack depth depends on code and mods, not GPU power. Increasing Xss reserves more native memory per thread.
jvm.pauseTip: G1 only. Starts at the standard 200 ms target; adjust after measuring GC logs. This target is not a maximum pause guarantee. Disabled and omitted for ZGC.
jvm.dedupTip: Optional G1 preset with a CPU cost. Off in the suggestion until profiling shows a benefit. Disabled and omitted from the command under ZGC.
jvm.loggingTip: Adds -Xlog:gc*=info. Collection events appear in the launcher log and the game console; useful for measuring before tuning.
jvm.g1Only: The pause target and this string-deduplication preset require G1. Select G1 or reset these options.
jvm.invalid: Invalid JVM settings. Check the memory limits, stack size and collector.

log.heap: Java allocation failed. Check the exact memory message and Xmx; investigate growth or a leak. More RAM alone may not fix it.
log.nativeMemory: Native/direct memory exhausted. Check available system memory and native buffers; increasing Xmx can reduce the remaining reserve.
log.binary: A binary read or integrity check failed. Inspect the named file and its version; compare a backup. This alone does not prove the whole save is corrupt.
log.javaVersion: A class targets a newer Java version than the runtime used.

log.dbLock: SQLite is busy or locked. Check for a running game/server or another editor using the same database.
log.map: Map/chunk loading problem. Follow the coordinates and file names, check map format and order, then compare a new world or backup.
log.checksum: Client/server files differ. Compare mod versions, load order and game build before reconnecting.
log.modMissing: A required mod could not be found. Check its ID, dependency list, installed files and Steam mode.
log.lua: Lua execution failed. Inspect the function/file and surrounding stack; a referenced mod is a lead, not a proven cause.

export.title: Export .bat / .sh
export.help:
Windows uses this PC's installation and cache. For Linux, copy the .sh and .assets folder together into the Linux game's root folder.

JVM settings and Java dependencies are included. Configuration, saves and traditional mods must be transferred separately. A README is included.
language.packsHelp: Add a JSON language pack here, then restart the launcher. A template and contributor guide are included. Missing translations use English.
